newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas blank, OTC consolidates Friday's falls.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas blank, OTC consolidates Friday's falls.

text.p: The IPE's natural gas futures contract got off to a slow start on Monday morning, with no trade done although bids and offers were seen in nearly all periods.

For months from October onwards, bids and offers were between 0.65 pence and 1.00 pence a therm apart, indicating the lack of real interest, although the bid/offer ranges were slightly narrower in July and September.

A trader on the physical market said that prices were still relatively low following the sharp falls on Friday, with more activity seen than is common on a Monday morning. The third quarter was reported to have traded several times, possibly as many as five, at around 10.45 to 10.50 pence a therm, in line with prices done on Friday but at the top end of the closing range.
And the gas year was said discussed in the range 13.10/13.20 pence a therm, in line with some of the deals done there on Friday but also at the top end of Friday's closing assessment.
